name: polly
description: Amazon Polly is a web service that makes it easy to synthesize speech from text.

subcommands.name: delete-lexicon
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified pronunciation lexicon stored in an Amazon Web Services Region.

options.name: --name
options.description: The name of the lexicon to delete.

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided.

options.name: --generate-cli-skeleton
options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.name: describe-voices
subcommands.description: Returns the list of voices that are available for use when requesting speech synthesis.

options.name: --engine
options.description: Specifies the engine (standard, neural, long-form or generative) used by Amazon Polly when processing input text for speech synthesis

options.name: --language-code
options.description: The language identification tag (ISO 639 code for the language name-ISO 3166 country code) for filtering the list of voices returned.

options.name: --include-additional-language-codes
options.description: Boolean value indicating whether to return any bilingual voices that use the specified language as an additional language.

options.name: --no-include-additional-language-codes
options.description: Boolean value indicating whether to return any bilingual voices that use the specified language as an additional language.

options.name: --next-token
options.description: An opaque pagination token returned from the previous DescribeVoices operation.

options.description: Prints a JSON skeleton to standard output without sending an API request.

subcommands.description: Allows the creation of an asynchronous synthesis task, by starting a new SpeechSynthesisTask.

options.name: --engine
options.description: Specifies the engine (standard, neural, long-form or generative) for Amazon Polly to use when processing input text for speech synthesis.

options.name: --language-code
options.description: Optional language code for the Speech Synthesis request.

options.name: --lexicon-names

options.description: List of one or more pronunciation lexicon names you want the service to apply during synthesis.

options.name: --output-format
options.description: The format in which the returned output will be encoded.

options.name: --sample-rate
options.description: The audio frequency specified in Hz.

options.name: --speech-mark-types
options.description: The type of speech marks returned for the input text

options.name: --text
options.description: Input text to synthesize.

options.name: --text-type
